records.Current: `_record_duration` creates a new `Histogram('function_duration_seconds', ...)` on every call; `logging_middleware.py` defines `http_request_duration_seconds` and `http_requests_total` directly, duplicating `metrics.py` definitions

records.Current: `dispatch_payout_batch` and `process_individual_payout` use `max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=60`; `retry_failed_payouts` uses `max_retries=1, default_retry_delay=300` — all fixed delays with no exponential backoff or jitter
